dataset_name: Johor Bahru Healthcare Master and Hospital Road-Network Access Snapping
snap_method: Nearest motor-vehicle candidate road segment by perpendicular projection.
critical_limit: The snapped point is a computational network access point. It is NOT asserted to be a verified physical hospital gate or emergency-department entrance.
primary_emergency_set: 3 public H1 acute/emergency hospitals + 11 D04-B private acute/emergency hospitals = 14.
hospital_permai_policy: Retained in master and hospital snap audit as special-purpose psychiatric hospital; excluded from primary emergency set.
